invariants.text: No engagement.firm_confirmed from agent_client, lifecycle_host or consumer roles.
tests: security: agent cannot create firm events
security: host key cannot sign firm events

invariants.text: No consultation.confirmed without a firm-signed event that names a confirmation reference and matches the user's proposed slot.
tests: consultation: confirm with wrong slot rejected

invariants.text: The OLIP 1.0 handoff machine is unchanged; no 2.0 state is ever written into a 1.0 handoff.
No user-visible firm reply is created from a transport or email notification; replies are firm-signed messages.
tests: messages: transport ack is not delivery

invariants.text: No consumer messages to an organization after the matter is closed or terminated, except a new authorized thread; firm closing communications are allowed.
Late, duplicate, replayed or out-of-order events never advance a projection illegally; duplicates are idempotent.
Two validly signed contradictory events for the same object revision produce a flagged reconciliation record, never a silent choice.
Each disclosure needs its own user grant bound to recipient, purpose, exact fields or content digest, revision, notice version, nonce and expiry. Grants never carry across recipients or passports.
tests: consent: grant reuse for other firm

invariants.text: A full CaseBrief may be disclosed to an organization only after that organization's conflict screen is eligible_for_further_intake.
Attendance, delivery and reading are never inferred from time passing or transport acceptance.
